messages:
marta: quick heads-up: onboarding a new magnet-30b-int4v4 variant for longctx QA. seeing reproducible token misalignment when prefill crosses 262144 tokens (and certain sub-block sizes).
ben: minimal repro? prefill or decode?
marta: prefill. stream ~270k tokens, then generate 64 tokens. generation diverges: repeated token triplets near the 262144 boundary. logits not NaN.
tessa: that boundary is 256k (2^18) + some. could be a tiling/tilt in our kv-shard math or a RoPE wrap/rescale edge. which runtime + flags?
marta: rdx-runtime:v2.11.0-int4v4, kernels=int4-dynfuse, prefetch_chunk=128B, kv-seq-align default. Deploy: magnet-30b-int4v4 -> pool-dedicated-7 (canary). deploy-bot: model deploy started: magnet-30b-int4v4 -> pool-dedicated-7
julian: paste KV offset dump and stitch message.
marta: dump snippet:
```
[2026-03-18T09:02:11Z] prefill_part=0 tokens=262144 kv_offset=262144
[2026-03-18T09:02:12Z] prefill_part=1 tokens=81920  kv_offset=344064
[2026-03-18T09:02:12Z] stitch: expected_offset=344064 seen_offset=344056
```
ben: gap=8 tokens. consistent small gap suggests pad/round-down somewhere. 128B chunking vs 64B expectation maybe.
tessa: also try toggling RoPE rescale: `--rope-rescale=1.0` vs `0.75`. if rescale path touches kv index sizes (it shouldn't) it might reveal interaction.
marta: ran quick A/B: rescale change didn't affect the stitch gap. forcing `--kv-seq-align=32` removed the gap. forcing `--kv-seq-align=128` made gap jump to 16. looks alignment-mask sensitive.
julian: ok that narrows it to alignment rounding for q-int4 dynfuse path. any memcpy/pad recent changes?
ben: we switched memcpy tail logic to prefer 128B granularity for performance on g5x last sprint. maybe we forgot to adjust token->byte rounding for int4 packed layout (4b per token key byte packing).
ci-bot: scheduled fuzz job longctx/tile-fuzz-1766000000 (neighbours around power-of-two boundaries). results link: https://ci.redwood/1766000000/tile-fuzz (artifacts uploaded)
ben: plan: 1) rollback memcpy tail change for int4 dynfuse on canary, 2) add a unit test in runtime-tests/longctx that streams border sizes: [262143,262144,262145] and also tile-subblocks [7,8,15,16] tokens, 3) add metric `stitch_gap_tokens` to rollout guard.
marta: PR draft up: rdx/runtime: fix int4 memcpy tail rounding + add longctx border fuzz. attaching repro script and kv-dumps to /mnt/experiments/1766000000/.
julian: run matrix across q4,q8,int4 and variants of prefetch_chunk {64,128} and kv-seq-align {16,32,64,128}. we'll want nightly matrix run and a canary rollout only if stitch_gap_tokens==0 across all variants.
ben: also add a tiny synthetic that prefill-repeats a single token N times to catch small-block packing regressions.
marta: thanks all. I'll monitor CI. deploy-bot: model deploy succeeded: magnet-30b-int4v4 -> pool-dedicated-7 (canary)
ci-bot: nightly matrix scheduled (job id: ci-1766000000-matrix).
